extension.summary: Play movies/episodes via one or more personal stream-only Stremio addons
extension.description: Standalone player for Stremio addons that only expose a "stream" resource (no catalog), such as Lumio.tv. Configure one or more of them, browse TMDB catalogues for movies, TV shows and anime, or search, then pick a stream to play directly, bypassing any torrent/debrid-oriented scraper pipeline. Requires a free TMDB API key.[CR][CR]This product uses TMDB and the TMDB APIs but is not endorsed, certified, or otherwise approved by TMDB.
extension.news: v1.0.0: - Renamed from Lumio to Bridgiodi - works with any stream-only Stremio addon - Multi-provider support: up to 5 Stremio manifests, priority-ordered - Local resume playback, without needing Trakt or TMDb Helper - Combined movie+series search with history, and Kodi global search support - Optional MDBList integration (Up Next, watchlist, lists, watched sync) - Optional original-language audio forcing - Dead auto-picked streams are now skipped instead of failing silently
